physical_roster_range_and_saved_usage_20.authority: new recorded read-only hardware observation; raw replies and saved captures retained privately

The saved-inventory analysis returned qualified absence for IDs within that supplied range. A fresh final live context matched the starting selection, saved and loaded buffers, and block status exactly.

A fresh context capture after the stopped query matched the starting selection, saved and loaded buffers, and block status exactly.
limits: The live capture reports range_complete, not roster_complete; there is no verified firmware end marker or count beyond the requested range
